notes: WHERE THE PHOTOS WERE TAKEN. 01/02/03 (IMG_2185-2187) are inside or at the mouth of a covered passage at the top edge of the patch, looking SSE down it to an iron gate with the sea beyond; 03 shows the tile sign 'CALLE JORGE 27 35' on the right-hand (west) wall just inside the arch. None of the three shows the pool or lawn and I could not tie the passage to an outline on this plan closely enough, so nothing is added from them (the passage, its sign, the two terracotta plant pots and the hanging lanterns belong to whichever patch covers z < 160). 04 (IMG_2188) was taken from under the awning at the lawn edge of the north-westernmost patio of the block north-east of the pool, about (-90, 171.5), 3 to 4 m from its pin, facing 171 deg as stated: the west ladder, south ladder and pump box all fall where the surveyed outline wants them with that heading. south-pool-02 was taken on the lawn about 4 m north of the deck, near (-90.5, 178), looking about 190 deg (SSW, not south-east): the pointed deck tongue and pump box are on the far side, the terrace west of the pool fills the right half and the sea is on the left. south-pool-01 was taken on the lawn south-east of the deck, near (-79.5, 194.5), looking about 305 deg (north-west rather than north): the pointed south tongue comes in from the left, the west tongue is on the far side and the steps are on the right; the building on the left is the same terrace west of the pool, the far white building is the row north-west of the cross path. My fix for this one is the weakest: bearings to the building come out about 6 deg different from bearings fitted to the pool fittings. south-pool-03 was taken from the north-west corner of the lawn, roughly (-105, 171), looking about 130 deg with a wide lens, beside the north end of the low curved wall; too loose to place anything from on its own. POOL. The surveyed outline matches the photos well: big NW and SE lobes, a SW lobe, deck tongues entering from the west (round), east (round) and south (pointed, one straight edge), and a short straight-sided stub on the north-east which is the entrance steps. A painted depth mark '150' is on the deck by the NW lobe and again by the SE lobe. The aerial pool sits 0.5 to 1 m west of the outline, as the brief says. NOT ADDED, NO FITTING KIND: two tall curved steel shower posts on the south-east side of the deck (probably the small white spur on the aerial at about (-87, 196.3)); frosted glass screens at the north-east and west of the deck; white pool-rules boards south of the deck; short dark-green bollard lights with a frosted top on the lawn (at least five: by the paved path south-west of the pool, and along the curved wall in south-pool-03); a slim modern lamp column near the seaward fence south of the pool; black wall lanterns either side of the big arched gate on the terrace west of the pool (wall-mounted, not posts); a crazy-paved path from the south-west of the deck through a gap in the low white wall to the end pavilion (pale patch on the aerial around (-88, 207)). NOT ADDED, COULD NOT PLACE TO 3 M: a big candelabra cactus/euphorbia at the far left of IMG_2188, down the patio row of the north-east block on a bearing of about 146 deg; it may be the round dark blob on the aerial at about (-75.8, 190.3) by that block's south corner, but south-pool-03 shows two thin palms in roughly that direction too and I could not tell which the blob is. A second tall candelabra cactus and a lot of magenta bougainvillea on the patios of the far white building in south-pool-01 (possibly the small dark blob on the aerial at about (-100.6, 168.4)). Red-flowered climbers on the terrace west of the pool in the web photos (round the door under the wooden balcony, and beside the end pavilion) are red not magenta and are gone or bare in IMG_2188, so not added as bougainvillea. The same clipped hedge carries on north along the whole front of that terrace in south-pool-01 and in front of the wooden-balcony house in south-pool-02, but I could not fix the gaps. Loungers, a white parasol and red chairs on the lawn in south-pool-03, and blue loungers on a far patio in south-pool-01, are movable and not placeable. LOOKS WRONG OR INCOMPLETE ON THE MAP: (1) the single-storey end pavilion at the seaward end of the terrace west of the pool: the photos show it standing forward (east) of the two-storey end wall by about 2 m, and the aerial shows a white flat-roofed block about 4.5 m square just south-east of the surveyed corner (-90.7, 210.9), outside the outline; I have not contradicted the outline but the south palm's z depends on it. (2) The low white walls: the photos show them ringing the pool on the west, south-west, south and north-west sides a few metres outside the deck, with a gap to the south-south-west for the paved path; the plan has none on the south or north-west. (3) All three web photos show the glass fence round the deck; left out by the owner's decision.
reviewNotes: Grid: on plan.png and aerial.jpg the labelled lines put the image edges at about x -119.5 / z 158.3, not exactly -120 / 158; I read positions from the grid lines. Around the pool the aerial sits only about 0.5 m west of the surveyed outline, not a full 1 m. Accepted but probably 1-2 m off: pump_box, I get about (-90.3,192.5), on the pointed tongue rather than behind it; the three low-confidence hedge metres in front of the arcade, I get the block about 1-1.5 m further south-east along the same line (z about 193-195.5); the 8 m hedge run could slide up to 2 m south-east along its line, and its 3 m stand-off from the house face is an assumption (the aerial does not show the hedge clearly; in the photos patio chairs stand on the pool side of parts of it). North-east life ring: I get about (-86.8,184). Rejected palm by the end pavilion: the palm certainly exists and should be added once the pavilion is settled; if the pavilion is the white flat-roofed block the aerial shows outside the outline (z about 212-217), the palm is near (-87.5,214) rather than (-89.3,210.6). The house outline there looks incomplete, as the proposer also says. Photo positions: I agree IMG_2185-2187 are in the Calle Jorge passage and show nothing in this patch, and that IMG_2188 was taken from the first patio of the north-east block at about (-90,171), facing about 171-173 degrees. IMG_2188 is not at the phone's widest setting: fittings fit a focal length of about 800 px on the 825 px wide frame. For south-pool-02 my own fit to the three deck tongues puts the camera further back, near (-92,170) with a longer lens, rather than the proposer's (-90.5,178); the bearings to everything round the pool are nearly the same either way, so no accepted item depends on which is right. south-pool-01 from about (-79.5,192.5) looking about 298-305 degrees agrees with the proposer. I agree with the proposer's out-of-scope list (glass fence, shower posts, bollard lights, rules boards, low walls, paved path) and none of it was proposed as an object.
